snippet.title: Tales After Dark: Something Upstairs — Official Trailer | Indie Horror
snippet.description:
A short found-footage horror. You rented the cheapest apartment you could find.
The landlady said one thing: "Don't go near the top floor."

Then the footsteps began — every night, above you.
But that apartment has been empty for months.

▶ Play FREE on itch.io: 
https://deitywater.itch.io/tales-after-dark-something-upstairs

Made by one person. Inspired by Fears to Fathom.
🎧 Headphones recommended. Play in the dark.

⚠️ Contains: sudden loud noises, jump scares, dark themes.

#horrorgame #indiehorror #foundfootage #talesafterdark #itchio #indiegame
